label: Eliashib

text.BHSA EZR 10:5: וַיָּ֣קָם עֶזְרָ֡א וַיַּשְׁבַּ֣ע אֶת־שָׂרֵי֩ הַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים הַלְוִיִּ֜ם וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לַעֲשֹׂ֛ות כַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה וַיִּשָּׁבֵֽעוּ׃
text.KJV EZR 10:5: Then arose Ezra, and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they should do according to this word. And they sware.
text.BHSA EZR 10:6: וַיָּ֣קָם עֶזְרָ֗א מִלִּפְנֵי֙ בֵּ֣ית הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיֵּ֕לֶךְ אֶל־לִשְׁכַּ֖ת יְהֹוחָנָ֣ן בֶּן־אֶלְיָשִׁ֑יב וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ שָׁ֗ם לֶ֤חֶם לֹֽא־אָכַל֙ וּמַ֣יִם לֹֽא־שָׁתָ֔ה כִּ֥י מִתְאַבֵּ֖ל עַל־מַ֥עַל הַגֹּולָֽה׃ ס
text.KJV EZR 10:6: Then Ezra rose up from before the house of God, and went into the chamber of Johanan the son of Eliashib: and when he came thither, he did eat no bread, nor drink water: for he mourned because of the transgression of them that had been carried away.
text.BHSA EZR 10:7: וַיַּעֲבִ֨ירוּ קֹ֜ול בִּיהוּדָ֣ה וִירֽוּשָׁלִַ֗ם לְכֹל֙ בְּנֵ֣י הַגֹּולָ֔ה לְהִקָּבֵ֖ץ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
text.KJV EZR 10:7: And they made proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem unto all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together unto Jerusalem;

A.name: Eliashib
A.line: father of Jehohanan in whose house Ezra mourned (EZR 10:6)
family: father-of jehohanan (Jehohanan, in his house, Ezra mourned over the unfaithfulness of Israel)

B.name: Eliashib
B.line: the high priest with Nehemiah during the reconstruction of Jerusalem (NEH 3:1)
family: high-priest-of yhvh (YHVH, the God of Israel)
descendant-of aaron (Aaron, brother of Moses (EXO 4:14) and Levitical priest (EXO 28:1))
son-of joiakim (Joiakim, son of Jeshua and father of Eliashib (NEH 12:10))

why: The Hebrew identifies Eliashib as the father of Johanan (יְהוֹחָנָן בֶּן־אֶלְיָשִׁיב), whose chamber Ezra entered, exactly matching A’s stated family relationship. The surrounding verses provide no identification with B’s high-priestly office or father Joiakim.
